title: IFT-13 — First Starship Catch
description: Predicted Q3 2026. S40 / B20. First attempt to catch Ship with Mechazilla arms. Nominal 6-engine burn to orbit. Booster catch at Starbase. Ship completes one orbit, reentry, Mechazilla catch attempt.
author: Markus Leutwyler

atcClearances.text: T minus 60 seconds. Starship is go for launch.
Liftoff. Starship lifts off from Starbase.
Stage separation confirmed. Hot-staging nominal. Ship ignition — all six Raptors.
Booster landing burn start. Mechazilla arms are go.
Booster 20 — caught. Mechazilla catch confirmed. Booster is secure.
SECO. Ship reached orbital velocity on all six Raptors. Nominal.
Payload bay open. Beginning Starlink simulator deployment.
Raptor engine relight confirmed. Ship performing on-orbit burn.
Ship entering the atmosphere. Reentry corridor nominal.
Ship 40 on approach to Starbase. Mechazilla arms are go for catch.
Ship 40 — caught. Mechazilla catch confirmed. First full stack recovered.

narrative: All six Raptors — nominal burn to orbit.
debrief: Did all six Raptors perform nominally through SECO?
Was the booster catch confirmed at T+7:54?
Did Ship 40 complete one full orbit before reentry?
Was the Ship catch the first time both stages were recovered on the same flight?
